name: sigelo-transfer
description: Direct file transfer for sigelo-contact: the WebRTC data channel (werift, pure TypeScript, no native code) behind sigelo-agent transfer. The relay carries only the introduction.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(process.env.SIGELO_PUBLISH!=='1'){console.error('refusing: publishing is a release step (release/RELEASE.md); publish the release/build.sh tarballs with SIGELO_PUBLISH=1');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: node test-dtls.mjs && node -e "import('./rtc.mjs').then((m) => m.selfTest()).then((r) => { console.log('ALL PASS (1): ' + r); }, (e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
